meta.audioTone: dry boardroom apocalypse, underplayed cruelty, no wink-to-camera jokes. nothing cinematic, nothing anime, nothing triumphant. institutional ambience over music. impact over juice on sfx. vocal grunts are sparse and reluctant — nobody is performing effort for the camera.
meta.boundary: Audio assets only: sfx prompts, stage music prompts, sprite-pack layout, and post-process directives. No gameplay rules, runtime selection, or HUD copy.

spritePack.description: Every sfx — weapon swipes, weapon hits, character grunts, objective cues, match-flow cues, win applause — concatenates into a single opus-in-webm sprite and a JSON manifest of [startMs, endMs] regions. The post-processor emits the sprite in the exact order listed under 'order'; the runtime triggers cues by name via the manifest, not by seeking raw offsets. One fetch, one decode, no per-trigger I/O.

swipe_flail.prompt: a short, heavy rope/chain-whip swipe through office air. the head is a weight on a flexible tether, so you hear a brief leather-creak or chain-shiver followed by the weight passing the mic. ~240ms total, mono, dry. no metallic ring-out, no fantasy whoosh; imagine a keychain lanyard with a battery pack on the end, swung once past a mic in a carpeted room. ends clean, no reverb tail.

swipe_maul.prompt: a slow, mass-heavy swipe. dominant low-mid air displacement, with the texture of something that does not want to be moving fast — a loaded duffel, a server chassis, a box of binders. 300ms, mono, dry, no whoosh stylization. the weight of the object is audible before it completes the arc. ends abruptly with a tiny fabric/strap creak.

swipe_blade.prompt: a tight, thin swipe — something rigid and flat cutting air cleanly. 170ms, mono, dry. specifically NOT a shing, NOT a metal ring, NOT a katana sample. think a stiff plexiglass sheet or a motherboard PCB cut quickly through the air, with the faintest edge-whistle and no tail.

swipe_greatsword.prompt: a committed two-handed arc. heavier than swipe_blade, longer arc, a little more air mass moved. 350ms. the sound communicates 'this was the whole commit, there is no follow-up this second'. mono, dry, no fantasy fanfare, no wind howl. ends with a small settling creak suggestive of whoever swung it rebalancing.

swipe_bat.prompt: a dry, short-stroke club swing. 220ms, mono. the sound of a rolled-up document (a thick bound constitution, a posterboard tube) being swung once — surface friction audible, no resonance. ends clean. not a baseball bat wooosh.

swipe_club.prompt: a stubby one-handed club swing. 190ms, mono. blunt object with no aerodynamic shape — you hear the air tumbling around it more than cutting. subtle. ends clean.

swipe_pike.prompt: a long-reach thrust. 260ms, mono. air parting along a narrow shaft, with a small lead-end whistle and a trailing pole resonance that cuts off sharply. committed, deliberate. not a spear-throw, not a javelin — a thrust that stops cold.

swipe_axe.prompt: a hinge-weighted swing. 280ms, mono. the head travels faster than the haft so there's a slight wobble in the air-texture mid-arc. ends with a tiny wood-grain creak from the handle settling. no metal gleam sfx, no lumberjack cliche.

swipe_nunchucks.prompt: two short connected weights whipping in sequence. 280ms, mono. you hear TWO rapid air-passes about 90ms apart, connected by a faint chain-rattle, then silence. deliberately unstylish — this is an improvised weapon, not a martial-arts showcase. no whoosh-whoosh movie sample.

hit_sama_worldcoin_orb_flail.prompt: contact: a coin-shaped metal puck on the end of a tether slaps an opponent. 190ms, mono. the front is a hollow metallic tap (not ringing, damped), followed by ~80ms of rattling tether settling. feels expensive and slightly absurd. no arcade ding, no boss-hit boom.

hit_sama_backpack_maul.prompt: contact: a heavy padded-weight impact, like a laptop backpack loaded with hardware hitting a torso. 210ms, mono. muffled thump up front, a fabric-brush trailing texture, no resonance. reads as 'that was a lot of mass, and the target has the wind knocked out'.

hit_sama_gpu_server_blade.prompt: contact: a thin rigid edge strikes target. 170ms, mono. dry plastic-composite crack (PCB snap texture), no metal ring, no blood sfx. reads as 'something expensive just broke against them'. ends clean.

hit_sama_heat_sink_greatsword.prompt: contact: a heavy finned-metal slab lands across an opponent. 230ms, mono. the impact is dominated by ribbed-metal rattle (fin vibration) overlaid on a dull thud. post-impact decay is short — the fins dissipate energy as high-mid chatter, then silence. no sword clang.

hit_darrius_rolled_constitution_bat.prompt: contact: a thick paper document — rolled, dense — whacks a target. 190ms, mono. a flat paper-on-body slap, no resonance, a faint page-edge flutter at the tail. feels bureaucratic and humiliating, not violent in a stylized way.

hit_darrius_alignment_baton.prompt: contact: a rigid short baton strike. 170ms, mono. a single clean tap, slightly higher frequency than bat, very dry. think a conductor's baton landing wrong. no rubber-mallet bounce.

hit_darrius_red_team_pike.prompt: contact: thrust-point lands. 200ms, mono. a sharp front transient (narrow cross-section impacting cloth-over-ribs), a very brief mid-frequency echo from the shaft, then silence. no blood or body-fall sample. feels like a point was made, literally.

hit_darrius_guardrail_greatsword.prompt: contact: a highway-guardrail-shaped slab strikes. 250ms, mono. lower-mid metallic thud with a perceptible flange/ribbed-steel character, followed by a brief industrial shudder as the guardrail profile resonates along its length and is then gripped back to silence.

hit_demis_nobel_medal_flail.prompt: contact: a heavy gold-weight medallion on a short chain connects. 190ms, mono. a round, short, damped metallic donk — like a solid puck, not a cymbal — followed by the medal spinning on its chain for ~60ms then held. dignified, not clangy.

hit_demis_folded_chess_axe.prompt: contact: the flat of a folded wooden/plastic chessboard, swung on a haft, strikes the target. 210ms, mono. a hollow cardboard-over-wood thud — the folded board gives a faint double-tap because the two halves hit a hair apart. ends clean.

hit_demis_go_board_maul.prompt: contact: a thick slab-wood go board, used as a maul head, lands with substantial mass. 230ms, mono. deep wood-on-body thud, a subtle grid-plate bounce texture suggesting stones shifting in their bowls but held inside the slab. no obvious 'bonk'.

hit_demis_alphafold_blade.prompt: contact: an impossibly thin computational blade connects. 170ms, mono. the impact transient is SHORTER than feels physically possible — an unnatural snap with almost no spectral content below 500 Hz and a very brief 3-5 kHz click, then silence. reads as 'this weapon does not obey the usual rules'.

hit_mark_sunscreen_bottle_club.prompt: contact: a plastic bottle full of thick lotion bludgeons the target. 180ms, mono. a wet-thick slap with a subtle liquid-slosh tail. comically, slightly, wrong — but not funny. ends clean after the slosh settles.

hit_mark_controller_nunchucks.prompt: contact: a hollow-plastic controller-shell, tethered, whips into the target. 190ms, mono. a bright plastic crack up front, then ~60ms of the second shell swinging in to tap again, slightly softer. no rumble. reads as cheap and stinging.

hit_mark_shareholder_sauce_club.prompt: contact: a heavy condiment-bottle club strikes. 190ms, mono. similar to sunscreen_bottle_club but thicker, denser, with a lower slosh register. a faint cap-rattle at the tail. unappetizing.

hit_mark_quest_flail.prompt: contact: a VR-headset-shaped weight on a short strap swings into target. 200ms, mono. dense plastic-and-foam impact, a lens-click element audible at the front (hard plastic rim striking), a brief strap-rustle tail. feels like an expensive gadget has been misused.

grunt_sama_effort.prompt: a quiet, non-performative exertion from an adult male voice — archetype: a quiet founder with an expensive weather system. 180ms, mono, close-mic, dry. think a half-exhale 'hhh' with a trace of voiced tone, almost whispered. not a fight-shout. delivered as if he's annoyed at having to exert himself at all.

grunt_sama_hurt.prompt: a short pained exhale, adult male, controlled, minimizing itself. 210ms, mono, dry. a clipped 'hnngh' or sharp nasal inhale as he absorbs a hit. no scream, no theatrical 'oof'. he is embarrassed to have been hit.

grunt_sama_ko.prompt: a defeated exhale, adult male, 470ms, mono. a breath leaving him all at once with a trace of vocal fry, ending in silence. no groan, no last-word, no dramatic fall-gasp. sounds like he is already thinking about what to say to the board.

grunt_darrius_effort.prompt: an adult male grunt with enforcer heft — archetype: risk posture with elbows. 180ms, mono, dry. a low, chest-voiced 'huh' on each swing, audibly weight-carrying, not theatrical. he sounds committed but bored, like a bouncer doing his job.

grunt_darrius_hurt.prompt: an adult male pained 'nngh', chest-voiced, slightly deeper than grunt_darrius_effort. 220ms, mono, dry. he takes the hit without flinching vocally; the grunt is the minimum his body lets him suppress. no yelp.

grunt_darrius_ko.prompt: a long, resigned exhale from an adult male, chest-voiced, 500ms, mono. the vocal fry is heavier than sama's. he sounds like he's filing an incident report as he falls. no cry, no last-breath drama.

grunt_demis_effort.prompt: a short, almost inaudible exhale from an adult male — archetype: polite recursion with unacceptable hands. 170ms, mono, dry. close-mic breath with a trace of voiced tone, politely muted. he sounds embarrassed to be making any sound at all.

grunt_demis_hurt.prompt: a tight, clipped hurt-exhale, adult male, upper register. 200ms, mono, dry. a sharp 'hn' rather than a groan. he is recalculating while being struck.

grunt_demis_ko.prompt: a quiet, collapsing exhale, adult male, 470ms, mono. longer than hurt, softer, trailing into breath-only. no words, no cry. sounds like a polite apology that has run out of air.

grunt_mark_effort.prompt: an adult male grunt with forced sincerity — archetype: optimized sincerity with blunt instruments. 180ms, mono, dry. a mid-register 'hyah'-adjacent effort sound that someone clearly thinks sounds natural and earnest. slightly too loud for the mic. the effort reads as marketed.

grunt_mark_hurt.prompt: an adult male hurt-grunt that still sounds like it was workshopped. 220ms, mono, dry. a slightly performative 'agh' that doesn't quite escape fully, clipped at the end as if he caught himself.

grunt_mark_ko.prompt: an adult male defeat exhale, 500ms, mono. starts as if he's going to say something (small vocal onset), then collapses into unvoiced breath. sincere-sounding, not sincere. no closing word.

dive_lunge.prompt: a short rush of displaced air with a hint of fabric tension — a suit jacket shoved forward quickly. 280ms, mono, dry. mild low-mid whump at the start from body weight, thin trailing hiss that ends abruptly. no anime air-slice, no synth dash. shared across all characters.

ko_flatline.prompt: a non-vocal defeat cue meant to layer UNDER the character's ko grunt. a single low thud against carpeted concrete followed by one flat, unresolved tone decaying in ~400ms — like an HVAC chime that never completes its phrase. mono, dry. administrative, not cinematic.

proof_spawn.prompt: the proof core appears in the arena. 280ms, mono. a soft magnetic-click up front (like a hard drive spinning up partway), then a brief held tone at ~440 Hz that decays over 200ms. reads as 'a small official object has just become real'. no chime, no sparkle.

proof_acquired.prompt: a fighter has picked up the proof core. 240ms, mono. a short, crisp mechanical click (the hand closing on the object) layered with a very brief 2-tone rising blip — two semitones, around 700 Hz — that feels like a receipt printer confirming something. understated.

proof_carrying_loop_fragment.prompt: a 500ms seamless-looping fragment meant to be played quietly and continuously while a fighter is carrying the proof. mono. a slow, steady low-amplitude hum at ~60 Hz with a faint crystalline shimmer at ~4 kHz that pulses once per 500ms. barely audible in the mix (-20 dB relative to sfx). the first and last 50ms are spectrally identical so the runtime can loop it as long as the carry lasts.

proof_delivered.prompt: the carrier completed the dwell and scored. 380ms, mono. a two-tone confirmation motif (perfect fourth, rising, 220Hz-to-293Hz) over a faint paper-stamp transient. reads as 'the receipt printed cleanly'. NOT a goal-scored fanfare, NOT a crowd reaction. purely administrative.

goal_spawn.prompt: a demand node has appeared — the target where the proof must be delivered. 260ms, mono. a low pulse (~80 Hz) rises and holds for 200ms, then cuts off. reads as 'a deadline is now running'. no chime, no sparkle. austere.

goal_tick.prompt: non-urgent per-second tick while the goal timer is running and > 3 seconds remain. 70ms of sound. a single dry clock-escapement click with a trace of desk resonance. low-volume in the mix. must tile once per second without fatigue.

goal_urgent_tick.prompt: urgent per-second tick when the goal timer is < 3 seconds. 110ms of sound. a flat, slightly harsh fluorescent-ballast alarm blip around 1 kHz, followed by 40ms of silence. unmistakable against goal_tick without being melodramatic. this is the 'alarm for small remaining time' — institutional, not arcade.

goal_expire.prompt: the goal timer reached zero without a delivery. 350ms, mono. a single short descending unresolved tone (400Hz down to 280Hz over ~120ms) followed by room tone. reads as 'the window closed, nobody got credit'. no buzzer, no failure stinger.

match_start.prompt: the match begins. a quiet institutional cue: double-beep from a fluorescent-lit conference phone, both beeps in 350ms, followed by 100ms of room tone. steady pitch, no swell. mono, dry. sounds like a meeting is starting, not a fight. fires on ws 'matchStart' only — NOT on 'matchInProgress' (mid-stream join).

round_start.prompt: a new round is beginning inside an ongoing match. 260ms, mono. a single short phone-beep (~200ms at steady pitch) followed by 60ms of room tone. quieter than match_start; rounds happen more often.

round_end.prompt: a round has ended. 300ms, mono. a low held tone that decays without resolution (~260 Hz for 240ms, then 60ms of silence). no stinger. sounds like the call-in line has dropped.

match_end_win.prompt: the match is over, someone won. a single low sustained unresolved tone (~450ms) followed by a short exhale of room tone. no fanfare, no chord resolution, no rising interval. stereo tolerated but narrow if used. sounds more like the lights have been turned off than like a victory. win_applause fires AFTER this cue, not simultaneously.

match_end_draw.prompt: draw result. identical texture to match_end_win but two tones detuned a quarter-tone apart, canceling into a faint beat. 500ms. mono. expresses 'nothing was decided' rather than 'both competed well'.

win_applause.prompt: audience reaction after a match win, but NOT a stadium crowd. a thin, small-room applause from a handful of people (4-8 claps audible) in a carpeted conference space, lasting ~2.2 seconds, slightly out of sync, a little too sparse to feel like a full room. add one late clap at ~1.9s from the back of the room. no cheers, no whistles, no vocal whoops. the emotional read is 'polite obligation' more than 'celebration'. stereo narrow. fires only on win, never on draw.

cold_aisle_chapel.prompt: a 48-second seamless ambient loop for a server room rendered as a chapel. constant low blower drone around 55-80 Hz, a steady fluorescent ballast hum near 120 Hz that never varies, faint intermittent hard-drive chatter as micro-percussive texture (not rhythmic). no melody. no chord progression. no drums. no pad swells. stereo field narrow and cold. the first 500ms and last 500ms must share identical spectral content so the loop seam is inaudible; do not fade in or out, and do not place a transient near either boundary. mixed with substantial air (~-22 LUFS).

fiduciary_basement.prompt: a 56-second seamless ambient loop for a basement-level corporate boardroom. foundation is an HVAC rumble around 40-60 Hz, a slow breathing low-frequency oscillation (one cycle every ~8 seconds) like a compressor cycling. no melody, no chord progression, no drums. add very sparse, slightly detuned long-held tones (cello or sine, 2-3 per loop, each 6-10 seconds, always dissonant to the last one by a minor second or tritone). stereo width narrow. boundaries: first 750ms matches last 750ms spectrally and phase-continuously; no transient near either end. target ~-22 LUFS.

demo_day_afterparty.prompt: a 64-second seamless loop for a stage whose art depicts the hour after a tech conference ends. the sound is muffled dance music bleeding through a closed door from two rooms away — heavily low-pass filtered (cutoff ~400 Hz), side-chained slightly so a ghost of the kick pattern is detectable but never fully audible. tempo around 122 BPM so it tiles the 64s window in an integer number of bars. over the bleed, add faint HVAC drone and distant intermittent voice murmurs (no intelligible words). feels like 'the party is ending and you are not in the room where it happened'. seam boundaries identical; integer bar count so the kick pulse is phase-continuous across the seam. target ~-22 LUFS.

triggerMap.swipe_{class}: fire when any fighter.swipeT transitions 0 -> positive in interpolated frame output. resolve {class} from fighter.loadout.weaponId -> weapon.class in the roster catalog (flail/maul/blade/greatsword/bat/club/pike/axe/nunchucks). fallback: swipe_blade if unknown.
triggerMap.hit_{char}_{weaponId}: fire when opp.hp decreases between consecutive frames. resolve {char} from the attacker's characterId and {weaponId} from their loadout. do NOT fire on swipeT alone — swings can miss. if manifest lookup fails, fall back to any hit_{char}_* then to hit_confirm is not in v1.1 so use the char's heaviest-class hit.
triggerMap.grunt_{char}_effort: fire together with the swipe cue on the attacker's edge. per-character throttle: suppress if same character emitted effort in the last 400ms (prevents machine-gun grunting during combos).
triggerMap.grunt_{char}_hurt: fire together with the hit cue on the victim's edge. same 400ms throttle.
triggerMap.grunt_{char}_ko: fire with ko_flatline on fighter.dead false -> true. ko_flatline is the non-vocal layer; the per-character grunt is the vocal layer. play both simultaneously.
triggerMap.proof_spawn: fire when the proof core spawns into the arena (observe state transition in frames — a proof entity appearing in the scene).
triggerMap.proof_acquired: fire when FighterTelemetry goes from not-carrying to carrying. resolvable via a carry flag on the fighter frame or from proof-entity carrier id.
triggerMap.proof_carrying_loop_fragment: start looping on proof_acquired, stop on proof_delivered OR on carrier death (whichever first). runtime plays this as a quiet bed, not a cue.
triggerMap.goal_spawn: fire when a demand node appears in frames.
triggerMap.goal_tick: fire once per second while goal timer is running AND timer > 3s.
triggerMap.goal_urgent_tick: fire once per second while goal timer is running AND timer <= 3s. suppresses goal_tick during the urgent window.
triggerMap.goal_expire: fire when goal timer reaches 0 without a delivery.
triggerMap.match_start: fire on ws message type 'matchStart'. NOT on 'matchInProgress' — that message represents a mid-stream join and should be silent.
triggerMap.round_start: fire at the start of rounds 2 and onward (not round 1 — match_start covers that). sim exposes round index per frame; trigger on round delta.
triggerMap.round_end: fire when the round index advances (delivery count reaches POINTS_TO_WIN_ROUND, or ROUND_TIMER_MAX_TICKS elapsed).
triggerMap.win_applause: schedule with a ~250ms delay AFTER match_end_win's onset. do not fire on draw.

integrationNotes.primePlaybackSuppression: After primePlayback() jumps the client to the newest frame on (re)mount or after trimPlaybackToLiveWindow(), the trigger layer must suppress ALL edge-detection-based cues for the first rendered frame — otherwise a backlog of buffered state differences fires every cue at once. Exception: match_start/matchEnd are driven by ws messages, not frame edges, and are safe.

playback.singleFile: The ENTIRE sfx set ships as one file — assets/audio/sfx/sprite.webm plus its manifest. No per-cue network I/O. Music tracks are separate per stage because loops are too long to sprite-pack.
playback.spriteSeeking: Decode sprite.webm once into a single AudioBuffer at first user gesture. Trigger via AudioBufferSourceNode.start(when, offsetSec, durationSec). Do not use HTMLAudioElement for the sprite — its currentTime seeks are not sample-accurate and will leak adjacent clips.
playback.voices: Allocate a small pool (e.g. 8) of AudioBufferSourceNodes. When a new cue arrives and all are busy, steal the oldest non-vocal cue (never steal grunts — they are short and distinctive). proof_carrying_loop_fragment owns its own long-lived node that is not stolen.
playback.music: one AudioBufferSourceNode per stage, loop=true, loopStart=0, loopEnd=buffer.duration. crossfade on stage change over 1.5s.
playback.masterToggle: single boolean in localStorage under 'm3t4:audio:on', default false. expose as a toggleSwitchHtml in the Live sidebar. when off, master GainNode.gain = 0 (do not tear down graph). flipping on for the first time does the one-time decode.
playback.firstGesture: AudioContext cannot start before a user gesture; lazy-init the graph on the first toggle-on click, not on page mount.

sfxPipeline: for each entry in spritePack.order: read raw generation from generations/raw/audio/sfx/<id>.wav
hard-cut or (if shorter than target) zero-pad to durationSec
loudness-normalize to meta.format.targetLUFS.sfx; peak-limit to meta.format.peakCeilingDb
concat in the exact order specified by spritePack.order
encode to opus @ 96 kbps in webm
emit manifest { [id]: [startMs, endMs] } alongside the sprite, using the pre-padding end so triggers don't include the pad in playback
musicPipeline: for each stageMusic entry: read raw generation from generations/raw/audio/stages/<stageId>/<variant>/music.wav
verify loop seam: spectral centroid of first and last 500ms must match within 3%; RMS within 1 dB; for demoday, additionally verify the loop length is an integer number of bars at the declared tempo
if seam verification fails, REJECT and log — never silently crossfade (crossfades mask on-theme 'administrative' framing and break the 'identical boundaries' prompt contract)
encode to opus @ 128 kbps stereo in webm
write to the entry's 'out' path under client/
promptBuilderHints: When tools/build-audio-prompts.mjs is built, include meta.audioTone at the top of every per-entry prompt — it suppresses the default cinematic/anime bias of most text-to-audio models.
For hit_* and grunt_* entries, also inject the weapon/character persona tag from the roster catalog so the generator has grounded character context.
For stage music prompts, inject the stage's visualTone fragment from theming/visual-theme.v1.json so the audio matches the visual art direction.
